abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves that match one of its types have a same-type attack bonus (STAB) of 2 instead of 1.5.

abilities.name: Aerilate
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Aftermath
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down. This effect is prevented if the move's user has the Magic Guard Ability or if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

abilities.name: Analytic
abilities.description: The power of this Pokemon's move is multiplied by 1.3 if it is the last to move in a turn. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight.

abilities.name: Anger Point
abilities.description: If this Pokemon, but not its substitute, is struck by a critical hit, its Attack is raised by 12 stages.

abilities.name: Anticipation
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted if any opposing Pokemon has an attacking move with a type that is super effective against this Pokemon, or any OHKO move. This effect considers Hidden Power to be its determined type, and every other move to be its original type.

abilities.name: Armor Tail
abilities.description: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

abilities.name: Aroma Veil
abilities.description: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

abilities.name: Battle Bond
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Greninja, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. This effect can only happen once per battle.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Special Attack is raised by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

abilities.name: Big Pecks
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Defense stat stage.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.

abilities.name: Cheek Pouch
abilities.description: If this Pokemon eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, in addition to the Berry's effect. This effect can also activate after the effects of Bug Bite, Fling, Pluck, Stuff Cheeks, and Teatime if the eaten Berry had an effect on this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.description: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

abilities.name: Cloud Nine
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

abilities.name: Contrary
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.

abilities.name: Corrosion
abilities.description: This Pokemon can poison or badly poison a Pokemon regardless of its typing.

abilities.name: Cud Chew
abilities.description: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it will eat that Berry again at the end of the next turn.

abilities.name: Curious Medicine
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon's allies have their stat stages reset to 0.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled unless one of the attacker's moves is already disabled.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.description: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max HP. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.

abilities.name: Dragonize
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sun.

abilities.name: Dry Skin
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sun. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.description: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.

abilities.name: Earth Eater
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Ground-type move.

abilities.name: Eelevate
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability. This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. Stat stage changes are not considered. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned, paralyzed, or fall asleep.

abilities.name: Electric Surge
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.

abilities.name: Electromorphosis
abilities.description: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.

abilities.name: Emergency Exit
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.

abilities.name: Fairy Aura
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Fairy-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.description: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

abilities.name: Fire Mane
abilities.description: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.

abilities.name: Flower Veil
abilities.description: Grass-type Pokemon on this Pokemon's side cannot have their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon or have a non-volatile status condition inflicted on them by other Pokemon.

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.description: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from contact moves, but double damage from Fire moves.

abilities.name: Forecast
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Castform, its type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella and the weather is Rain or Sun.

abilities.name: Forewarn
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the move with the highest power, at random, known by an opposing Pokemon. This effect considers OHKO moves to have 150 power, Counter, Mirror Coat, and Metal Burst to have 120 power, every other attacking move with an unspecified power to have 80 power, and non-damaging moves to have 1 power.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.description: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Defense is doubled.

abilities.name: Gale Wings
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.description: When this Pokemon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum HP instead.

abilities.name: Good as Gold
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.

abilities.name: Gooey
abilities.description: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Grass Pelt
abilities.description: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Grassy Surge
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.

abilities.name: Guard Dog
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability and raises its Attack by 1 stage instead. This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Attack is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon's physical attacks ignore the burn effect of halving damage.

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.description: If the last item this Pokemon used is a Berry, there is a 50% chance it gets restored at the end of each turn. If Sun is active, this chance is 100%.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.description: 50% chance this Pokemon's ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Heatproof
abilities.description: If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon takes half of the usual burn damage, rounded down.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.description: This Pokemon's weight is doubled. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone.

abilities.name: Hospitality
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

abilities.name: Hunger Switch
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Hustle
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the accuracy of its physical attacks is multiplied by 0.8.

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.description: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Hyper Cutter
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: If Snow is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

abilities.name: Illusion
abilities.description: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's actual level and HP are displayed instead of those of the mimicked Pokemon.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

abilities.name: Imposter
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it. If there is no Pokemon at that position, this Pokemon does not Transform.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a move, that move's user loses HP equal to the amount of damage inflicted on this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.description: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

abilities.name: Klutz
abilities.description: This Pokemon's held item has no effect. This Pokemon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.description: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.

abilities.name: Libero
abilities.description: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

abilities.name: Light Metal
abilities.description: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

abilities.name: Liquid Ooze
abilities.description: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

abilities.name: Liquid Voice
abilities.description: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.description: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.description: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

abilities.name: Magician
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.

abilities.name: Magma Armor
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

abilities.name: Marvel Scale
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.description: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.

abilities.name: Mega Sol
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sun were active.

abilities.name: Merciless
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.description: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.

abilities.name: Minus
abilities.description: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Mirror Armor
abilities.description: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Moody
abilities.description: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

abilities.name: Mummy
abilities.description: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.description: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.description: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Opportunist
abilities.description: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Parental Bond
abilities.description: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.description: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.

abilities.name: Piercing Drill
abilities.description: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

abilities.name: Pixilate
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Plus
abilities.description: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Poison Heal
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.description: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.description: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.description: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

abilities.name: Psychic Surge
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.

abilities.name: Punk Rock
abilities.description: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

abilities.name: Purifying Salt
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Queenly Majesty
abilities.description: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.

abilities.name: Quick Feet
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.description: If Rain is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Rattled
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokemon affected this Pokemon with the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Receiver
abilities.description: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2. Does not affect Struggle.

abilities.name: Refrigerate
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.description: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

abilities.name: Ripen
abilities.description: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.description: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.description: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.description: No competitive use.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.description: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sand Rush
abilities.description: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sand Spit
abilities.description: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.

abilities.name: Sand Stream
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.description: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.description: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Screen Cleaner
abilities.description: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.

abilities.name: Seed Sower
abilities.description: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.description: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell, are a Ghost type, or also have this Ability.

abilities.name: Sharpness
abilities.description: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Shed Skin
abilities.description: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3, but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

moves.name: Flying Press
moves.description: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

moves.name: Focus Blast

moves.description: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.description: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

moves.name: Forest's Curse

moves.name: Gastro Acid

If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

moves.name: Jet Punch
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: King's Shield
moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Attack lowered by 1 stage. moves.name: Magnet Rise

If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the user is under any of their effects. Fails if the user is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

moves.name: Sludge Wave

moves.name: Smack Down

If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Snap Trap
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Snipe Shot

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.

moves.name: Snowscape
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. During the effect, the Defense of Ice-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a physical attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Snow.

moves.name: Soak
moves.description: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move still requires a turn to charge.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move still requires a turn to charge.

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.description: If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of its burn.

moves.name: Speed Swap

moves.name: Spicy Extract
moves.description: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and lowers its Defense by 2 stages.

Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.description: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Whether or not this move is successful, the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.

moves.name: Spore
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25×, 0.5×, neutral, 2×, or 4×, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. moves.name: Strength Sap

moves.name: String Shot

moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Stun Spore

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

moves.name: Sunny Day

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Supercell Slam
moves.description: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

moves.description: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Swagger

moves.name: Swallow
moves.description: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. moves.name: Sweet Kiss

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.

moves.name: Syrup Bomb

moves.name: Tail Slap

If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

moves.name: Tailwind

moves.name: Taunt

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.description: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.description: Causes the target to become confused.

moves.name: Temper Flare

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.description: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.description: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

moves.name: Torch Song
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. moves.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.description: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

moves.name: Triple Arrows
moves.description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.description: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Twin Beam
moves.description: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

moves.name: U-turn

moves.name: Upper Hand
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Venoshock

If the user is an Ash-Greninja with the Battle Bond Ability, this move has a power of 20 and always hits three times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Ice type during Snow, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. moves.name: Will-O-Wisp

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
